stories.headline: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
stories.dek: Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents instead of people. It uses less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks, helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.
